## Result and credit

Complete negative answer to the original unrestricted positive-definite Hessian-metric stability question (6000016 / AMR-059-0016, item 5(b), printed p.126). A complete volume-preserving affine torus deforms smoothly from the standard Hessian torus, while every noncentral member fails the Hessian Codazzi/Stokes test.

The affine family is already in Baues–Goldman, arXiv:math/0401257v2, §5 p.20. The packet gives the direct arbitrary-metric nonexistence argument. No novelty, first-resolution, or human peer-review claim is made. Hyperbolic, fixed-linear-holonomy and indefinite-metric variants are excluded from the claim.

## Repository scope

Based on fresh main f63a97ada19c9b377e7aa2073d30e301f94a4c45. All 14 packet files plus QUEUE.md were fetched back from this exact head and matched the intended content. The diff contains only this attempt folder and this row's Status, Turns and previously empty Findings cells: claimed_solved, 1/5 (complete early). All other queue bytes, including the existing header and links, are preserved.

The live aggregator returned HTTP403; the original printed question was visually checked independently. Source PDFs, full source texts, raw corpora and private context are excluded. No queue.py invocation, merge, release or DOI. Draft for review.
